What is digital content creation?

Digital media content creation is the making of the posts, videos and stories your channels publish, and Pixelbrahma produces them in-house so the creative stays aligned with your brand and strategy.

What we create

  • 01

    Creative content development

    We generate ideas from your audience's questions and your business strengths, then turn them into a repeatable set of formats.

    • Content pillars and themes
    • Graphics, carousels and short posts
    • Captions and copy in your voice
  • 02

    Storytelling and branding

    Good content connects facts to feeling. We shape the story of your product, people and purpose so it stays consistent over time.

    • Brand story and tone guide
    • Customer and founder stories
    • Visual style applied across posts
  • 03

    Video production

    From short vertical clips to longer explainers, we plan, shoot and edit video that holds attention.

    • Scripting and storyboards
    • Shooting and editing
    • Captions and platform cut-downs
  • 04

    Platform-specific content

    Each channel has its own shape. We adapt sizes, length and style so content feels native wherever it appears.

    • Format guidelines per platform
    • Thumbnails and cover images
    • Variants for testing

Content we have created

Posts, graphics and video thumbnails.

Our content workflow

  1. Step 1

    Brief

    We confirm goals, audience and the key message of the month.

  2. Step 2

    Concept

    You choose from a short list of ideas and formats.

  3. Step 3

    Produce

    We write, design, shoot and edit the approved pieces.

  4. Step 4

    Approve

    You review in one batch and request changes.

  5. Step 5

    Publish and learn

    Content goes live and performance guides the next brief.

Mistakes to avoid when planning digital content

Short, practical lessons from projects like yours.

  1. Mistake 1

    Reusing one format everywhere

    Do this instead

    Shape each piece for the platform: short video for reels, carousels for learning, clean graphics for announcements.

  2. Mistake 2

    Making content with no clear message

    Do this instead

    Start every piece with one idea and one action you want the viewer to take.

  3. Mistake 3

    Running out of content mid-month

    Do this instead

    Produce in monthly batches so approvals are simple and the calendar always has a buffer.

What to prepare before we start on digital content

Having these ready lets us give you a sharper estimate and a faster first draft.

Send us your brief
  • Your brand guide or examples of the look you want
  • Product samples or locations we can shoot
  • Key messages and offers for the next month
  • Approval contacts and turnaround expectations

What decides the cost of content creation

We never quote blindly. After a short discovery call we send a written estimate that lists exactly what is included, so you can compare it with confidence.

Get a written estimate
  • +The formats you need, such as posts, reels or films, and the monthly volume
  • +Design depth: from template-based layouts to fully custom work
  • +Content: whether you supply copy and images or we create them
  • +Timeline: urgent launches need more people working in parallel
  • +Support: a one-off delivery or an ongoing monthly retainer

Content creation FAQs

Formats, video, revisions and languages, answered.

Ask us directly
Do you shoot video on location?

Yes, where it suits the project. We plan the shoot, crew and schedule with you in advance.

Can you match our existing brand style?

Yes. We follow your brand guidelines, or help you create them through our branding service.

How many revisions are included?

The proposal states the number of revision rounds per piece so you know what to expect.

Can content be made in regional languages?

We can discuss this for your project.

What kinds of content do you create for social media?

Static posts, carousels, short videos, reels, stories, product shots and campaign creatives, all designed for the platform they will run on.

Do you produce video for brands in Bengaluru and Kochi?

Yes. Our team plans, shoots and edits brand videos, product films and social video, and works with scripts, voice-over and music.

Can you create a monthly content calendar?

Yes. We plan topics, formats and posting dates a month ahead, so the content stays consistent and you can approve it in advance.

Brief us on your next content batch

Tell us what you are working on. We will reply with questions and a suggested next step.
